title: My Reaction To The Thermostat
trend: Instagram Reels & TikTok 'My Reaction To ___' (October 2026) — start with the smallest number and a flat stare, then escalate the reaction each round as the number grows; set during the first cold week of October when every US household fights over turning the heat on
youtube_title: My dad's reaction to the thermostat, round by round 🌡️
description:
Every round the number goes up. So does Dad. Nobody touches the heat in October… or do they?

lines.text: Okay. My reaction to the thermostat. Starring my dad.
Kayla, put the phone down. It's October. Nobody touches the heat in October.
Good evening. I am the thermostat. I have been touched.
Round one. Somebody set it to sixty-five.
Sixty-five.
That's fine. That's a sweater number.
I am wearing a scarf indoors. Draw your own conclusions.
Dad, the cat is cold.
The cat has a fur coat. Built in. Free of charge.
This coat was not free. I paid for it with my dignity.
Round two. Somebody set it to sixty-eight.
Sixty-eight?
Do you know what sixty-eight costs? It costs a vacation.
We don't go on vacations.
Because somebody keeps setting it to sixty-eight!
I'd like to say I feel very warm and very blamed.
In this house we have a system. Cold? Put on a sweater.
And if you're still cold?
Second sweater.
And after that?
After that, you become a man.
I have been a cat for six years. I am not becoming a man for you.
Round three. Seventy-two.
Seventy...
Seventy-two is not a temperature. That's a sauna. That's an insult to the furnace.
I can hear the money. I can hear it leaving through the windows.
Dad, the windows are closed.
Money finds a way, Kayla!
Everybody line up. Who touched the dial?
Not me. I was under three blankets doing homework.
Mittens. Where were you at four o'clock?
On the warm spot by the vent. Like a professional.
May I speak? I have something to confess.
Make it quick. Every second is a nickel.
I am not connected to anything.
What?
Never have been. Not since you moved in. Nine years. I'm decorative.
So every time he yelled at you...
I just nodded and showed a number. It was always a very nice number.
Then who controls the heat?
The little box in the basement. Behind the litter.
It's very warm. I sit on it. Sometimes I sit on it harder.
The cat. The cat has been running the house.
Round four. My reaction to the cat paying nothing and controlling everything.
That's my dream job.
Final round. I just set it to eighty.
Eighty?
Dad. Your reaction?
I'm going to go stand in the basement.
Bring a sweater. Then a second sweater. Then become a man.
